MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink assortment feels useful alongside my nuts, bolts, and washers because it offers several sizes for small practical repairs.",
    "The solder seal connectors fit the same hands-on DIY interests, although I would wait for an actual wire-splicing job before choosing them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The large red tubing has a specific size and use that my recent small hardware purchases do not establish a need for.",
    "The air regulator and thermal camera require projects or equipment I have not shown an interest in, while the inspection tags, water tester, and medical supplies serve unrelated needs.",
    "The sealing tape could be useful for a repair, but I have no leak to fix; general usefulness is not enough for me to choose it now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying hardware seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or maintenance supply, even when it serves a very different task.",
    "My purchases of assorted fasteners do not mean that any bulk supply, such as a thousand gloves, would be useful to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in magnetic hooks points toward hanging and organizing things, while the washers and screws point toward fastening small parts.",
    "An item can fit my practical interests without being something I need now. I rarely choose anything unless I can see a concrete use for it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my practical DIY interests but stretched them beyond my current fastening, organizing, and small-repair needs."
}
